editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: RoboForex is a technically legit broker — 17 years of operation, FSC Belize licence 9759600, Financial Commission membership with $20,000 dispute resolution — but it carries the weakest regulatory profile in our entire 2026 review queue. No FCA. No ASIC. No CySEC. One single offshore regulator and a Trustpilot score of 2.6/5 that sits well below industry average. The 12,000+ instrument range and interest paid on deposits (3.0%-3.5% annually) are genuine differentiators that experienced traders may value, and the ECN/Prime accounts offer competitive raw pricing. But the withdrawal fee structure — commission-free only on the 1st and 3rd Tuesday of each month — is actively trader-unfriendly, and the February 2026 finding of EU client onboarding via Lithuanian banking without an EU licence is a compliance concern that could escalate. You are not dealing with a confirmed scam, but you are dealing with a broker where zero Tier-1 regulatory protection means zero backstop if something goes wrong. Experienced, risk-aware traders with a specific need for massive instrument choice or R StocksTrader may find value here. Everyone else should look at FBS or IC Markets first.
